variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the built-in administrator account used to access the admin interface.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the built-in administrator account. Choose a strong unique password before exposing the app.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Random secret used to sign admin session cookies. Generate a long unpredictable value.

variables.name: DB_PATH
variables.description: SQLite database path. Relative paths are resolved from config/.env; use ../data/main.sqlite for Uppr.

variables.name: TRAITS_DIR
variables.description: Directory containing trait markdown files. Relative paths are resolved from config/.env; use ../data/traits for durable Uppr storage.

variables.name: ADDR
variables.description: HTTP listen address. Use :6688 or 0.0.0.0:6688 so the Docker container accepts external traffic.

variables.name: ACCENT_COLOR
variables.description: CSS accent color used by the web interface.
